title: ReciprocityView
description: Per-agent reciprocity ledger — inflow (others hosting for me) + outflow (me hosting for others) + net + capacity. Source of truth: derived from rea_commitments and economic_events using the T03d action conventions (Operational, Category C). Reconstructed per request; not persisted.

agentCid.description: Agent CID this reciprocity view is scoped to.

inflow.description: Reciprocity rows where the counterparty hosts content for the viewer.

outflow.description: Reciprocity rows where the viewer hosts content for the counterparty.

netHostedBytes.description: Signed net hosting position. Positive = others hold more for me than I do for them.

capacityAvailableBytes.description: Spare capacity the viewer can offer to expand reciprocity.
